reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Verified at reconstruction.go:79-82. Go map iteration is randomized, cellsIndices built via map iteration without sorting before passing to RecoverCellsAndKZGProofs (L86). Spec SG-024 explicitly requires sorted cell_indices (q_assert_sorted state). Test fulu__kzg__recover_cells_and_kzg_proofs_test.go confirms library rejects unsorted input.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Spec SG-024 recover_cells_and_kzg_proofs requires q_assert_sorted: cell_indices == sorted(cell_indices)

reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Verified at p2p_interface.go:34-52. VerifyDataColumnSidecar checks len > 0 and length consistency but does NOT validate max_blobs_per_block limit. Spec SG-002 verify_data_column_sidecar explicitly includes q_check_max_blobs state (L14-17) requiring rejection when len(kzg_commitments) > get_blob_parameters(epoch).max_blobs_per_block. Missing epoch-aware blob count validation enables oversized sidecar acceptance.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Spec SG-002 verify_data_column_sidecar INV-003: kzg_commitments count must not exceed max_blobs_per_block for the epoch

reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code at loader.go:29-73 accepts YAML without explicit fork epoch ordering validation, but InitializeForkSchedule() (L70, defined at config.go:393-404) calls merge() which sorts entries by epoch and prepare() for validation. The spec SG-001 get_blob_parameters shows sorted schedule handling. While stricter YAML validation would prevent misconfiguration, the sorting step ensures runtime correctness. Attack requires deliberate testnet misconfiguration, not a production consensus vulnerability.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Spec SG-001 get_blob_parameters shows epoch-sorted schedule processing (q_sort state)

reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Verified at validate_data_column.go:36-38. Self-peer bypass is intentional trust model differentiation. Local validator's own messages are trusted by design (validator client is part of the same trust boundary as beacon node). Spec SG-006 data_column_sidecar_gossip_validation applies to P2P gossip from untrusted peers. Compromised local validator is out of scope (requires root/process access to validator client). This is spec-compliant behavior, not a vulnerability.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Spec SG-006 applies to P2P gossip validation; local validator is same trust boundary as beacon node

reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Verified at rpc_blob_sidecars_by_root.go:26-109. Handler lacks epoch-based deprecation guard. No check for current_epoch >= FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS. Spec SG-013 blob_sidecars_by_root_deprecated explicitly requires q_check_deprecated state with q_fully_deprecated transition to respond empty or reject after deprecation epoch. Handler continues serving indefinitely as long as data exists in retention window.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: Spec SG-013 blob_sidecars_by_root_deprecated INV-001: Deprecated after FULU_FORK_EPOCH + MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOB_SIDECARS_REQUESTS
